# Runtime secret keys

| Key | Encrypted owner | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `SEPAY_IPN_SECRET_FILE` | `.stacks/dev/runtime/files/sepay-ipn-secret.key.enc` | Optional path override; the default decrypted file supplies the dedicated `X-Secret-Key` for inbound SePay Payment Gateway IPN callbacks. |

The decrypted file is generated by `npm run sync` and must never be committed.
